question: For male legislators from Louisiana, how many distinct legislators were actively serving on December 31 of each year from more than 30 years since their first term up to less than 50 years, grouping the results by the exact number of years elapsed since their first term?
sql:
WITH male_la AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT lt.id_bioguide
    FROM legislators l
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE l.gender = 'M' AND lt.state = 'LA'
),
first_terms AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(TRY_CAST(term_start AS DATE)) as first_term_start
    FROM legislators_terms
    WHERE id_bioguide IN (SELECT id_bioguide FROM male_la)
    GROUP BY id_bioguide
),
legislator_terms AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT lt.id_bioguide, TRY_CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) as term_start, TRY_CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) as term_end
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    WHERE lt.id_bioguide IN (SELECT id_bioguide FROM male_la)
),
all_dec31 AS (
    SELECT TRY_CAST((1800 + n) || '-12-31' AS DATE) as dec31_date
    FROM generate_series(0, 250) AS g(n)
),
legislator_dec31 AS (
    SELECT 
        ft.id_bioguide,
        ft.first_term_start,
        a.dec31_date,
        date_diff('year', ft.first_term_start, a.dec31_date) as years_elapsed
    FROM first_terms ft
    CROSS JOIN all_dec31 a
    WHERE date_diff('year', ft.first_term_start, a.dec31_date) > 30
    AND date_diff('year', ft.first_term_start, a.dec31_date) < 50
)
SELECT 
    ld.years_elapsed,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.id_bioguide) as count_distinct_legislators
FROM legislator_dec31 ld
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM legislator_terms lt2
    WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ld.id_bioguide
    AND lt2.term_start <= ld.dec31_date
    AND lt2.term_end >= ld.dec31_date
)
GROUP BY ld.years_elapsed
ORDER BY ld.years_elapsed
